notes: Nine facts: commencement dates from CBK's own agent-banking presentation, appointment/register/liability rules from the E-Money Regulation 2013, and three qualitative findings from the FSD Kenya 2010 channel-regulation report. No numeric cash-in/cash-out limit per agent exists in the Kenya corpus; float is described only as the agent's own working capital.

sources.name: Central Bank of Kenya, E-Money Regulation 2013 (National Payment System Act)
Central Bank of Kenya, Agent Banking Knowledge Exchange (AFI presentation)
FSD Kenya / Bankable Frontier Associates, Regulation and Supervision of Bank Channels: Policy Options for Kenya (Jan 2010)

entries.subject: agent_banking_commencement
entries.value_text: Agent banking became legally effective in Kenya on 1 January 2010
entries.quote: agent banking effective 1st january 2010 and cbk had to prescribe guidelines
entries.notes: CBK presentation; enabling amendments were tabled in parliament in June 2009.

entries.subject: agent_banking_guidelines_effective
entries.value_text: CBK agent banking guidelines were issued in April 2010 and took effect on 1 May 2010
entries.display: Guidelines issued April 2010, in force 1 May 2010
entries.quote: agent banking guidelines issued in april 2010 to take effect from 1st may 2010

entries.subject: agent_appointment_notice_period
entries.display: An e-money issuer must tell CBK at least 60 days before starting to operate through agents
entries.quote: e money issuers that intend to appoint agents shall at least 60 days prior to commencing the conducting of the business of an e money issuer through agents advise the bank in writing of their intention
entries.notes: The notice must include recruiting procedure, agent locations, the standard agency agreement and the agent manual. effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: agent_register
entries.value_text: Issuers must report agent names, owners, GPS coordinates and outlets monthly, and CBK publishes them in a public electronic register of agents
entries.display: There is a public CBK register of agents
entries.quote: the identity of the persons responsible for the management of the agent and the bank shall insert this information in a public electronic register of agents
entries.notes: effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: issuer_liability_for_agent
entries.value_text: The e-money issuer is liable to accountholders for its agents' conduct within the agency agreement, and cannot contract out of that liability
entries.display: Agent misconduct is the issuer's problem, not the customer's
entries.quote: e money issuers are liable to their e money account holders for the conduct of their agents performed within the scope of the agency agreement the agency agreement cannot exclude such liability
entries.notes: effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: agent_eligibility
entries.value_text: Agent must hold the licences or permits its commercial activity needs, be lawfully able to provide the service, be financially sound and have competent management
entries.display: Four cumulative conditions for appointment as an agent
entries.quote: e money issuers may appoint through written agency agreement a person as agent if that person a possesses such registrations business licenses or permits as may be required for the performance of its commercial activities
entries.notes: Appointment must be in writing (clause 9.4). effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: agent_fee_add_on
entries.value_text: Agents may not add their own fees; the principal pays the agent and alone recovers fees from the customer
entries.display: Agents cannot charge customers on top of the published tariff
entries.quote: the conventional wisdom is to prohibit agents from adding on fees instead fees are paid by the principal who alone may recover fees from the customer
entries.notes: FSD Kenya policy report for CBK; a design recommendation that matches the tariff structure, so treat as single_source.

entries.subject: agent_float_shortage_prevalence
entries.value_text: One in five respondents in a 2008 survey had found an agent unable to pay out cash
entries.display: Agent cash-out shortages are common but usually resolved by walking to the next agent
entries.quote: this indeed has been the experience with m pesa agents where as many as one in five of survey respondents in a 2008 survey had encountered this issue but in general merely went to another agent
entries.notes: Float is the agent's own working capital; no CBK-mandated minimum float is stated in the corpus for Kenya (unlike the e-money issuer's 100% liquid-asset rule).

entries.subject: branch_vs_agent_liquidity
entries.value_text: A branch carries an implicit bank liquidity guarantee to clients; an agent does not
entries.display: Only branches guarantee cash; agents can run dry
entries.quote: a bank branch carries an implicit guarantee of liquidity by the bank to its clients whereas an agent does not
